$comment: QR-18: each crate's floor for line and region coverage of the native test run, as `cargo xtask coverage` measures it (one `cargo llvm-cov --workspace` run; every workspace test counts toward every crate). A floor starts at the first measured value rounded down and only goes up: a measurement under it fails, and so does a floor more than headroomPoints below it, so the PR that earned the coverage raises the floor (`cargo xtask coverage --update` only raises). Lowering a floor is a hand edit with its reason here.

bindings/native-fixture.reason: a minimal binary that exists so the hardening and reproducibility gates have a subject; it has no tests and nothing to cover

bindings/wasm.reason: first measured 2026-11-08 at 66.25% lines and 60.04% regions; the per-module test exports (edge_router, coincident_ends) are exercised by the wasm differentials, not natively

core/det.reason: first measured 2026-11-08 at 98.81% lines and 98.68% regions

core/edge-routing.reason: first measured 2026-11-08 at 94.47% lines and 94.57% regions, with the wasm crate's replay of the TypeScript's recorded answers (71.37% and 69.20% from the crate's own tests alone); raised with the native properties to 97.06-97.34% lines and 96.72-96.94% regions over four runs. Generated boards still move spatial_edges.rs by about nine lines, so the floor sits a point under the lowest run; the coincident-ends repair, which a board reached only sometimes and which moved the crate by 2.8 points, has a fixed example of its own. Raised again with the survivor tests (tests/survivors_*.rs) to 99.01-99.04% lines and 98.82-98.83% regions over three runs; the floor stays a point under the lowest

core/log.reason: first measured 2026-11-08 at 100% lines and regions

testing/proptest.reason: first measured 2026-11-08 at 98.63% lines and 96.90% regions

xtask.reason: first measured 2026-11-08 at 57.43% lines and 55.14% regions; raised to 60.48% and 58.05% once the coverage command's logic was split out and tested (the mutation gate's first catch), and to 65.53% and 63.55% once a test ran the whole codegen over the repository (the mutation gate's catch on the input-caps generator). The commands that build, run tools or need a release toolchain are exercised by running them in rust:check, not by unit tests
